Subject: Q3 close: deal risk roll‑call & stabilization plan for CloudWave

Team / Sanjay —

We’re coming up on the quarter close and Finance asked for a quick roll‑call on CW-2026-0911 (CloudWave). Current forecast shows this deal as Yellow with a $420k FY22 ARR contribution on the book if it lands. Before I lock numbers with Finance today, I need a short update on the points below so we can decide whether to keep this in commit or move to upside.

Quick asks (please reply in-thread):
- Current decision timeline from CloudWave — is legal signoff still week of Oct 4?
- Any open procurement/PO blockers we should know about?
- Confirmation of POC acceptance criteria and delivery date (affects start-of-billing timing)
- Which mitigations (pricing credit / 60‑day pilot / premium onboarding) are you comfortable offering if they push?

Sanjay, can you confirm procurement path (PO vs. direct SOW) and whether RevOps needs a new PO template? If you can attach the final SOW or PO draft, that’ll help finance finalize revenue recognition assumptions.

I’ll collect replies and produce a short save‑plan with owners by EOD PT.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudWave‑MVP‑SOW‑v2.pdf (draft SOW, redlines expected)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudwave.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave RevOps <revops@cloudwave.io>
Date: 2026-09-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 close: deal risk roll‑call & stabilization plan for CloudWave

Vanessa, Ben —

Thanks for the nudge. Quick answers below and attaching the SOW.

1) Decision timeline: legal has a 1–2 week review; we still expect signature target of Oct 5 but if legal asks for changes it could slip to Oct 12.
2) Procurement: we prefer a PO against an approved SOW. RevOps will raise the PO but need your final SOW (we attached a slightly annotated version).
3) POC acceptance: our engineers validated feature parity in the sandbox last week. Acceptance criteria are minor (latency SLA verification, a short security attestation). We expect sign-off within 5 business days of receiving final SOW.
4) Mitigations: a 45‑day pilot + 10% implementation credit would make procurement comfortable. We prefer credits applied to the first invoice.

I’m attaching CloudWave‑MVP‑SOW‑v2.pdf with inline comments. I’ll follow up with RevOps internally for the PO timeline — expect a formal PO request within 72 hours after SOW confirmation.

— Sanjay
Head of Product Partnerships
CloudWave

Adding a quick sales update and my proposed labeling for R/Y/G lists. Thoughts?

Short update from my side: we ran the commercial review yesterday — CloudWave's exec sponsor verbally committed to the plan but procurement/legal are the gating items. The PO preference increases time-to-collect risk slightly.

Probability and recommended current classification:
- Probability: 65% (down from 75% two weeks ago)
- Suggested list: Yellow (commit monitor) — finance should plan for 60% recognition probability for Q4 planning unless PO is in hand by Oct 7.

Proposed save‑plan actions (owners and ETA):
- Finalize SOW w/ CloudWave redlines incorporated — Owner: Vanessa, ETA: 2026-09-27 15:00 PT (I can review pricing comp)
- Offer 45‑day pilot + 10% credit (pricing approval given) — Owner: Ben, ETA: 2026-09-27 12:00 PT (I’ll circulate an approval note)
- Legal expedited review request (AR escalation) — Owner: Karthik, ETA: 2026-09-28 09:00 PT
- Finance provisional recognition note with conditional probability — Owner: Michael, ETA: 2026-09-28 12:00 PT

If the PO is not submitted by Oct 7 we should move to upside for the quarter close.

Ben
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
